newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass sees continuing margin pressures.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass sees continuing margin pressures.

text.p: Sunglass Hut International Inc said on Thursday that it expects margin pressures to continue into fiscal 1997 as the company further reduces its inventories.

The retailer, which reported a fourth quarter loss after restructuring charges, said its margins were depressed in the fourth quarter of "fiscal 1996," ended February 1, 1997, from product returns, exchanges and order cancellations, combined with a slowdown in sales.
Sunglass Hut said its fourth quarter results were hurt by continued weakening of comparable and new store sales trends, certain store closing costs and charges related to its strategy.
The company had previously announced plans to eliminate marginal or unprofitable sites, it said.

Sunglass Hut discontinued its EyeX optical stores concept so the company could concentrate its resources on existing locations most likely to achieve sales and profits that justify its investment, the company said.
Sunglass Hut operates 2,030 specialty locations, 28 EyeX optical stores and 54 Watch Station stores.
